label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived from new java.util.Random().nextGaussian(), which is cryptographically weak for security-sensitive session/authentication tokens used in cookies and session attributes. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes param from request.getHeader('BenchmarkTest00163') which is user-controlled input written directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding. Both represent real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness: new java.util.Random().nextGaussian() used for rememberMeKey cookie/session token
XSS source: param = request.getHeader('BenchmarkTest00163') retrieves user-controlled header value
XSS sink: param concatenated into response.getWriter() output without HTML encoding
